title: Monitoring Use of Telecommunication and Internet Services for Online and Phone Scams
what_it_is: Monitoring Use of Telecommunication and Internet Services for Online and Phone Scams

sections.label: Scam monitoring and public education
sections.summary: Mobile and Internet service providers monitor networks for scams and assist enforcement agencies, while Government agencies conduct public education and outreach programmes.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: Today, mobile and Internet service providers already monitor their networks for scams based on complaints from consumers and assist enforcement agencies by providing information for investigations on suspected scams.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: To this end, Government agencies, including the Infocomm Media Development Authority (IMDA) and the Singapore Police Force, work with the National Crime Prevention Council to conduct public education and outreach programmes, especially to groups which are more likely to fall prey to scams.

sections.label: Interface with other telecommunications regimes
sections.summary: There is a necessary consideration on how to interface with other telecommunications regimes and services, and no regulations are being planned at this point in time.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: So, there is a necessary consideration on how we will interface with other telecommunications regimes and services.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: We continue to study the matter and there is, at this point in time, no regulations that are being planned.
